# POCTEP 2021–2027: energy and climate thematic register
Based on the official approved operations and partners lists.
## Derived extracts (overlapping categories; never sum them as distinct projects)
| File | Scope | Projects | ERDF approved (EUR) |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [thematic_energy_projects.csv](thematic_energy_projects.csv) | All 21 P3 OE2.1/2.2 energy projects plus 5 reviewed energy R&D/skills projects (26 total) | 26 | 32890199.20 |
| [thematic_energy_communities.csv](thematic_energy_communities.csv) | 6 directly focused on energy communities or energy-sharing pilots | 6 | 8521631.08 |
| [thematic_climate_adaptation.csv](thematic_climate_adaptation.csv) | P3 OE2.4 climate adaptation, disaster risk and resilience (not the same as climate planning) | 17 | 51490153.11 |
| [thematic_climate_plans.csv](thematic_climate_plans.csv) | 5 reviewed projects with explicit planning, local strategies or municipal action guidelines | 5 | 4596837.60 |
| [thematic_climate_energy_models.csv](thematic_climate_energy_models.csv) | 2 integrated local climate-energy development models (Huella Zero I and II) | 2 | 3160248.14 |

## Source and interpretation
- Parent inventory: [projects.csv](projects.csv), [partners.csv](partners.csv), and [quality.json](quality.json).
- Territories are programme cooperation areas; partner-level NUTS mapping must be validated separately.
- 'Energy communities' is a subset of energy projects. Climate plans, adaptation and energy may overlap.
- Eligible project investment is not systematically available for calls 6–8. Use project ERDF unless checked separately.
- Recomputed automatically when the source registry refreshes. Taxonomy code is versioned in the public repository.
